record.field: Malaysia monthly payroll: EPF (employee & tiered employer), SOCSO and EIS (capped), and PCB income tax via the annualised progressive schedule with individual + EPF relief. Rates come from the Malaysia legislation pack. PCB uses the annualised method with two reliefs — the official MTD schedule with full reliefs is a v1 limitation.
